svg.title: Whole-project source checkpoints: 34 of 46 landed; 12 open, including one in progress. Production acceptance: 0 of 6 verified.
svg.desc: Six compact rows show every stable parent ID once: evidence E01–E10 landed 10/10; historical H01–H04 landed and H05 open 4/5; permissions G01–G10 landed 10/10; finalization F01–F07 landed and F08 in progress 7/8; workloads N01–N03 landed and N04–N06 open 3/6; operations O01–O07 open 0/7. Parent source total remains 34/46 landed and 12 open, including one in-progress parent. F08 has 19/26 detailed leaves landed and 7 open, with no active leaf. Step 19 completion/history is source-landed in f59e050079e89d98d982a082a05dd619e09fa9e7. Its five diagnostic components are historical replay 74ff9e89edf577c7de1e8a107d2b9326052867cb, historical custody/recovery 91fcafdf9d3816a2449e211bb35752ca26bbb0c8, real cold bootstrap/key/readers/TLS/service, signed state peer and original response receiving. These five are inside step 19, not additional checkpoints. Custody/execution is 6/7 source pieces, private replay remains 8/8. Step 20 protected one-use token release is NEXT/open; six public/portal leaves remain open. Generic activation completion APIs remain rejected; the dedicated path requires historical custody. Every segment retains its task title and status mark. Counts are source checkpoints, not whole-product or effort percentages. Source is unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned; signed completion is not token release or current browser-session state. All six production gates remain unverified.
